decisions.thought: Opponent has a bulky balance with Kingambit, Sinistcha, and Archaludon. Garchomp with Focus Sash leads well to set Stealth Rock and scout; Kingambit handles Sinistcha/Gholdengo, and Rotom-Wash covers Incineroar and Archaludon.

Incineroar gives Fake Out and Intimidate against their physical attackers (Garchomp, Kingambit, Dragonite). Garchomp is fast and threatens Kingambit and Dragonite with Earthquake and Mega speed. Gholdengo resists Sylveon's Fairy attacks and hits Dragonite and Rotom-Wash with Thunderbolt.
decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Looking at team preview against their garchomp, kingambit, gholdengo, rotomwash, sylveon, dragonite, I'm weighing their fairy and steel/dark threats against what I can bring. Incineroar's intimidate and fake out plus parting shot seem valuable, and I'm considering how my kingambit matches up against their gholdengo.

I think leading with Incineroar to blunt their physical attackers makes sense, followed by Garchomp for speed and ground coverage against Kingambit, and Gholdengo since its steel typing resists fairy damage from their Sylveon while threatening their water and dragon types with electric and ghost moves. Settling on Incineroar, Garchomp, and Gholdengo as my team.
